"text": "SESSION 4-JUL-2026 PART 2: Fixed dashboard auto-start risk - pgrep pattern now matches bot_stable.py (was matching bot.py, always false), removed automatic ./slh_daemon.sh launch entirely, relabeled as Local Bot to clarify it does not reflect Railway production status. NOTE: dashboard DB health check (option 4) still checks stale schema fields (students, courses, admins, etc) that do not exist in current db.json schema (users, agents, tasks, memory, votes) - cosmetic, low priority, not fixed this session."

"text": "SESSION 4-JUL-2026 PART 3 - Economic engine audit: Found marketplace.py wrote to /app/marketplace.json (ephemeral container disk, NOT Volume) - active data-loss risk, would reset on every deploy. FIXED: changed STORE_FILE path to state/marketplace.json, preserved existing data (health_check, task_plugin, agent_os, junk_cleaner plugins) by copying to new location before code change. Verified live on Railway post-deploy - code and file both confirmed at new path. ALSO DISCOVERED (not yet fixed): (1) TWO competing /join handlers registered - learn_handlers.py and welcome_handler.py both claim commands=[join], likely causing referral flow to silently fail since welcome_handler writes db[students] without referral_code field that learn_handlers /referral expects. (2) welcome_handler.py and learn_handlers.py bypass state_manager.py entirely, doing raw json.load/dump on relative db.json path instead of using the centralized DB access built last session - same single-source-of-truth risk as journal.json had. (3) Local Termux state/db.json was significantly stale vs Railway live db.json (missing students/courses/admins keys) - must always pull live data via /exec before doing local DB work. (4) orphaned join_fix.py file present in root, unclear if still relevant. NEXT SESSION: resolve duplicate /join handlers, migrate welcome_handler.py and learn_handlers.py to use state_manager.py, decide fate of join_fix.py."

"text": "SESSION 4-JUL-2026 PART 5 - Admin menu audit found 4 duplicate handlers in bot_stable.py (start, demo, logs, refreshtoken). Telebot only runs first-registered handler, rest were dead code. MAJOR FIX: refreshtoken handlers were re-registering every reconnect loop iteration inside while True - moved outside loop entirely, matches known risk flagged in prior session memory. "text": "SESSION 4-JUL-2026 PART 8: Discovered parallel work completed economic engine - econ_handler.py with /balance, /buy, /giveme all live and verified working (tested balance 170 -> 160 after /buy ask_credit, real DB writes confirmed). admin_utils.py created to house is_admin() avoiding circular imports. Removed 10 additional dead one-off fix scripts (fix_add_broadcast.py, fix_lock.py, onboard_patch.py, etc). Tagged gold-v1.0 (post economy-fix, pre-cleanup) and gold-v2.0-clean (post full cleanup) as rollback points. Working tree fully clean, Railway Online, POLLING START confirmed multiple times across all deploys with zero errors."

SLH_DISCOVERY_20260802_211429.txt:3283: journal.json:    "text": "SESSION 4-JUL-2026 PART 3 - Economic engine audit: Found marketplace.py wrote to /app/marketplace.json (ephemeral container disk, NOT Volume) - active data-loss risk, would reset on every deploy. FIXED: changed STORE_FILE path to state/marketplace.json, preserved existing data (health_check, task_plugin, agent_os, junk_cleaner plugins) by copying to new location before code change. Verified live on Railway post-deploy - code and file both confirmed at new path. (2) welcome_handler.py and learn_handlers.py bypass state_manager.py entirely, doing raw json.load/dump on relative db.json path instead of using the centralized DB access built last session - same single-source-of-truth risk as journal.json had. (3) Local Termux state/db.json was significantly stale vs Railway live db.json (missing students/courses/admins keys) - must always pull live data via /exec before doing local DB work. (4) orphaned join_fix.py file present in root, unclear if still relevant. NEXT SESSION: resolve duplicate /join handlers, migrate welcome_handler.py and learn_handlers.py to use state_manager.py, decide fate of join_fix.py."

Removed 10 additional dead one-off fix scripts (fix_add_broadcast.py, fix_lock.py, onboard_patch.py, etc). Added docs/ (4 Railway inventory/ownership markdown files), manifest.json, and daily tooling scripts (slh_morning.sh, slh_full_diag.sh, slh_safe_diag.sh, pre_change_audit.sh, railway_pre_fix_check.sh, telegram_owner_check.sh) to git tracking so they survive and sync properly. Working tree fully clean, Railway Online, POLLING START confirmed multiple times across all deploys with zero errors."

Removed 10 additional dead one-off fix scripts (fix_add_broadcast.py, fix_lock.py, onboard_patch.py, etc). Tagged gold-v1.0 (post economy-fix, pre-cleanup) and gold-v2.0-clean (post full cleanup) as rollback points.
